Model and data

LightGBM forecasts weekly demand under eligible offers and peer discount pressure. Piecewise-linear demand curves feed Google OR-Tools MPSolver with SCIP. The optimizer chooses one offer per product group and week and balances PepsiCo and retailer revenue and margin while respecting business rules.

Sample data is synthetic. The sample holdout WAPE was 9.7% versus 17.9% for the group-median baseline. The reported score combines four equally weighted financial metrics.
